Answer the questions on the basis of the information given below. There are 8 friends - A, V, L, M, N, O, P and Q - who are sitting in a circle. It is also known that:
i.    Q is sitting to the immediate right of N.
ii.   O is sitting opposite to V, who has 2 people sitting between J and himself.
iii.  L is sitting opposite N and second to the left of O.
iv.  O and M are neighbours.

If J switches his place with the person opposite him, then who of the following cannot be neighbour of J?

Direction for questions :

Amarpreet, Daljeet, Gurmeet, Harpreet, Inderjeet, Jasmeet, Kuwarjeet, and Parmeet are 8 people (4 males and 4 females) sitting around the circumference of a circular table with each person sitting equidistant from the 2 people adjacent to him/her. All of them are facing the centre of the table. Gurmeet is sitting opposite Inderjeet and Harpreet is sitting opposite Amarpreet. Parmeet is 2 positions to the right of Amarpreet. Harpreet is to the immediate right of Daljeet. Jasmeet is adjacent to Gurmeet. Males and females sit at alternate positions.

If we move in the anticlockwise direction, then how many people sit between Daljeet and Inderjeet (excluding both Daljeet and Inderjeet, and if we start counting from the person sitting to the immediate right of Daljeet)?

Direction for questions :

Six friends Dilip, Gopal, Jay, Karan, Raj and Uday meet after a very long time and decide to go out for a drink at Poptates. They were seated on a circular table and the chairs are numbered 1 - 6 in a clock wise manner. Also it is know that each of them ordered a different drink. Also, the chair numbers of both Uday and Gopal were perfect squares.
Uday and Dilip were sitting adjacent to each other. The person who ordered Beer sat on chair number 3 while the one who ordered whiskey sat on chair number 6. The person who ordered vodka sat opposite to Jay and next to Raj. The chair number of the person who ordered rum was neither prime nor composite. Dilip ordered either beer or breezer. The person who ordered breezer was next to the persons who ordered rum and beer. One of them ordered wine.

Who ordered wine?
